title: Flow of Funds
tagline: We create an app to display how money flows on Ethereum. This makes it easier for everyone to understand how money moves.
description: The idea is to index on-chain data and show how money flows between accounts over time. Users input an account and can see which accounts interacted with it and how strongly they did. At the moment, we display other accounts in a circle around the target account but we want to improve it by changing the account position based on how often and with how many funds it interacted with.
how_its_made: We index on-chain data and store it in a graph database.  We use a graph database so it's possible to ask questions in terms of how money moved between accounts, for example we can ask "all accounts that interacted with any account that interacted with the target account". The visualization is done with react and visx. We use Remix for the frontend and backend.
